title: Best Marketing Automation Experts (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a marketing automation expert: CRM and email workflows, what to include, how to brief it, price factors and red flags.
intro: Marketing automation sends the right message at the right time without manual work: welcome sequences, lead follow-ups, reminders and updates to your CRM. Done well, it saves hours and makes sure no lead is forgotten. It goes wrong when workflows are built without a clear plan, contacts are messaged without consent, or nobody knows how the automations work after the expert leaves. This guide helps you set it up properly.

faq.a: Common examples are welcome emails, lead nurturing, abandoned cart reminders, follow-ups after purchases, lead scoring and updating contact records in your CRM.
Email platforms, CRMs such as HubSpot or similar tools, and connectors like Zapier or Make. The expert should work with tools you already use where possible.

faq.q: Do I need consent to email contacts?
faq.a: In many countries, yes, for marketing messages. Rules differ by region. Ask how consent is recorded and respected in the workflows.

faq.q: How do I know automations are working?
faq.a: Ask for tests of each workflow, clear reports, and alerts for errors. Check a few contacts manually after launch.

faq.q: What if I change tools later?
faq.a: Ask for documentation of every workflow, so it can be rebuilt elsewhere.
